Hey all, like everybody on here I am keen to get the errata cards and promos but the shipping is scary expensive! So I'm thinking that there must be a good few of us that could bundle together to split the cost and then I will split the order and use internal post at this end. First of all - Paul/Christopher will this be okay with you guys? Second question - if so, who wants in?

posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked: Go for it. We'll make it work on this end.
posts.raw: Go for it. We'll make it work on this end.

posts.name: Mezike
posts.cooked:
Cheers lad!

Another thought - no reason not to scale this out to the EU as posting a letter is not much more than internal post. I have a non-forumite buddy who will want in so that starts us with two. Hopefully we can get up to ten or so? My thoughts are we split the cost and then it's 60p on top for a stamp (90p for EU), I should be able to provide envelopes at no extra cost!
